tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /zhing skyong dbang po zhal bzhi pa'i thugs dam skang zhing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i yi ge bsam don myur 'grub bzhugs// na mo gu ru badzra dha ra buddha dhwa dza ye/ hūm̐ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ /gang thugs ye shes ngo bor ro gcig pa'i/ /rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas mnyes byed pa'i/ /mthun rdzas dngos 'byor yid sprul bsam mi khyab/ /sa dang bar snang khams gsum khyab pa 'dis/ /thugs dam skong zhing nyes ltung ma lus bshag /zhing skyong 'khor bcas rab tu dgyes gyur cig /da ni 'dod pa'i 'phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bstan pa 'phel zhing yun du gnas pa'i phyir/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /rigs rgyud dri med lo zla ma 'gyangs par/ /myur du 'byung ba'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzod/ /gtad do gnyer ro zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel don kun lhun grub mdzod/ /ces zhing skyong dbang po zhal bzhi ba'i thugs dam skong zhing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i yi ge bsam don myur 'grub ces bya ba 'di yang / sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis lhag bsam dag pas sbyar ba 'dis zhing skyong dbang po rab tu dgyes nas bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //'phrin las kyi mgon po pu tra chen po'i thugs dam skong zhing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i yi ge bsam don myur 'grub bzhugs/ ༄/ /na mo gu ru badzra dha ra buddha dhwa dza ye/ hūm̐ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ /gang thugs ye shes ngo bor ro gcig pa'i/ /dam can mon bu pu tra mthu rtsal can/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas mnyes byed pa'i/ /mthun rdzas dngos 'byor yid sprul bsam mi khyab/ /sa dang bar snang khams gsum khyab pa 'dis/ /thugs dam skong zhing nyes ltung ma lus bshag

/las mkhan 'khor bcas rab tu dgyes gyur cig /da ni 'dod pa'i 'phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bstan pa 'phel zhing yun du gnas pa'i phyir/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /rigs rgyud dri med lo zla ma 'gyangs par/ /myur du 'byung ba'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzod/ /gtad do gnyer ro las mkhan 'khor dang bcas/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel don kun lhun grub mdzod/ /ces 'phrin las kyi mgon po pu tra chen po'i thugs dam skong zhing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i yi ge bsam don myur 'grub ces bya ba 'di yang / sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis lhag bsam dag pas sbyar ba 'dis pu tra chen po rab tu dgyes nas bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ zhing skyong dbang po zhal bzhi pa'i thugs dam bskang zhing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i yi ge PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
